claim: Deleting the already-applied migration 1780592070031-ConvertNegativeRatingToNull (live on main for ~3 days via published :main images) will make kysely's Migrator.migrateToLatest throw 'corrupted migrations: previously executed migration ... is missing' (ensureNoMissingMigrations is unconditional in kysely 0.28.17) and DatabaseRepository.runMigrations rethrows, so affected servers will not boot; the safe alternative is to keep the file with a no-op up(). Separately, users who already ran it have had -1 ratings irreversibly converted to NULL, which the PR description should mention.
raw: 1. Deleting an already-applied migration will prevent affected servers from starting.

claim: Replacing .min(1).max(5) with .refine(...) makes the rating bounds unrepresentable in zod's JSON-Schema emitter, so the OpenAPI spec collapses to minimum/maximum ±9007199254740991 (spec lines 16606-16607, 26429-26430) and the Dart client documents that range; every generated client and spec-driven validator now believes any safe integer is valid. Use z.int().min(-1).max(5).nullable().refine(v => v !== 0) (or a union of literal -1 and int 1-5) to restore the published bounds.
raw: 2. The OpenAPI contract no longer expresses the valid range at all.

claim: BaseSearchSchema.rating is still .min(1).max(5) with the .updated('v3', 'Using -1 as a rating is no longer valid.') history entry, propagating to MetadataSearchDto, RandomSearchDto, SmartSearchDto, StatisticsSearchDto and the rating query parameter (spec minimum: 1), so a client can PUT rating -1 but gets 400 searching for it, and asset.dto.ts and search.dto.ts now tell contradictory v3 histories.
raw: 3. The revert is partial — search still rejects -1, so -1-rated assets are unfindable.

claim: ExifResponseDto.rating is still z.int().min(1).max(5).nullish().default(null) (spec line 18671 minimum: 1) while the server will now return -1; currently documentation-only since no handler uses @ZodSerializerDto, but it becomes a serialization exception once the project's TODOs to adopt ZodSerializerDto are acted on.
raw: 4. The revert is partial — ExifResponseDto documents minimum: 1 but the server will return -1.

claim: Metadata extraction still uses validateRange(exifTags.Rating, 1, 5), which returns null for -1, so the standard xmp:Rating 'rejected' value from Lightroom/digiKam sidecars is dropped on import while the same value set via the API is kept; meanwhile handleSidecarWrite (lines 509, 523) writes a DB -1 out to the .xmp, a value the extractor then discards. API-set ratings are protected by lockedProperties so the gap is limited to externally authored -1, but the asymmetry should be an explicit decision.
raw: 5. The revert is partial — XMP ingestion still discards -1, and Immich now writes a value its own reader refuses.

claim: The updated controller spec only asserts rejections (7, 3.5, -2); the tests that covered acceptance of -1 ('should set the negative rating' in e2e asset.e2e-spec.ts and 'should handle valid negative rating value' in metadata.service.spec.ts) were deleted by #27896 and not restored, so a regression re-restricting -1 would pass CI. Add -1 and null to the accepted side and restore the e2e test.
raw: 6. Nothing tests that -1 is accepted — the entire point of the change.

claim: There is no test for rating: 0, even though the new history entry declares 0 newly invalid in v3 and it is the one value whose behavior this PR changes relative to both the pre- and post-27896 states (the refine rejects it; the old min(-1) bound accepted it).

Removing the v2.6.0 x-immich-history entry rewrites a shipped API changelog that did announce the -1 deprecation; keeping the v2.6.0 entry and adding a v3 entry stating -1 is supported again would be more honest and would stop asset.dto.ts and search.dto.ts from disagreeing about v2.6.0. Nothing in HistoryBuilder (decorators.ts:199-250) enforces append-only.
raw: 8. Deleting the v2.6.0 history entry rewrites a published changelog.

claim: Rating descriptions have drifted: asset.dto.ts:23 says 'Rating in range [1-5], -1 (rejected) or null (unrated)', search.dto.ts:41 still says 'Filter by rating [1-5], or null for unrated', exif.dto.ts:32 just says 'Rating'; and 'rejected' is a new user-facing concept not documented anywhere, including docs/docs/features/xmp-sidecars.md.
raw: 9. Description drift across the rating surface.

claim: The web UI's Rating type is 1|2|3|4|5|null and asset.exifInfo?.rating || null is cast as Rating (DetailPanelStarRating.svelte:16), so a -1 rating escapes the type: no stars fill and no radio is checked, but ratingSelection !== null so the 'clear rating' control renders (StarRating.svelte:104). Pre-existing and cosmetic, but this PR makes it reachable again.
raw: 10. The web UI renders a -1 rating as an unrated asset that offers a "clear" button.

raw: 11. Commit message typos: udpate tests, gen clientc.
